**Match the head repository before treating a pull request as existing.**

If a fork has an open pull request from `chore/ai-review`, this branch-name lookup can match that pull request. The installer then reports that its pull request exists and does not create one for the branch it updated. Use a lookup that identifies both the head repository and branch, such as the REST pull-request filter with `head=<repo-owner>:chore/ai-review`. `gh pr list --head` cannot accept an owner-qualified branch. ([cli.github.com](https://cli.github.com/manual/gh_pr_list?utm_source=openai))

**Fail immediately on HTTP 413.**

If the endpoint rejects the request as too large, this branch retries the same request after the configured delay. The second attempt cannot reduce its size. Add 413 to the permanent-error statuses. ([platform.claude.com](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors?utm_source=openai))

Based on learnings, HTTP 413 is a non-retryable client error.

+            if result.get("api_error_status") in (400, 401, 403, 404, 413):

**Verify that the health response comes from the new proxy.**

If another service already listens on port 4000, that service can return 200 before the new LiteLLM process reports its bind failure. `start_proxy` then gives Claude Code the other service’s URL. The review can fail, and the other service can receive the review request. Reserve a per-run port and confirm that the started proxy owns the listener before returning its URL.
